notes.title: Time to RAMPAGE!
notes.content:
YO! We got a new game mode for you apes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/bea3bfda32e985c3406b7a4965bfb0db55fe2aa0.png

This game mode is intense non-stop action, with on-the-fly upgrades.
It's gonna challenge your skills and your physical endurance.

Your goal: smash as many tons of metal as you can before the bots (or a heart attack) take you out.

You'll earn Bronze, Silver, and Gold medals as you progress and upgrade your mech - but combat challenges will start piling up as well, making the enemy bots stronger and stronger.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/054780d7699d151ad426dc9502338c95dcc5370f.png
Every week a new Weekly Set (aka seed) of bots and upgrades will be generated, with its own leaderboard to compete over. You can also just play a Random Set to mix things up whenver you want.

We're stoked about RAMPAGE and hope it will scratch the itch for all you adrenaline junkies, fitness buffs and optimizers out there.
 
...


...But you know us by now, we couldn't help ourselves and also added a bunch of other things to this update. For example:

There's now a NEW RUN menu allowing you to choose your starting weapons:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/7b83cef6d26f2364293a81f03dda007068d773c9.png

We also made bashing a lot more fun and effective, made a ton of item changes, and more. 
You can read about all in the news feed here.


GL HF
- One Hamsa

notes.title: VR Camera Toolbox
notes.content:
Sup all!

While we're at work on bigger upcoming updates, we decided to polish and roll out a tool we made for internal use: the VR Camera Toolbox.

[previewyoutube=9k-7B_QpjBM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Camera Toolbox lets you setup cameras and capture the game, all from inside VR*.
Toggle it on during combat from the Settings menu and it'll appear in your cockpit.

Some of its features:

 Record landscape or portrait
 Use a selfie cam, third person cam, stationary cam, and more
 Slow down time (Sandbox only)
 Preview last recording
 Hide bubble from recording camera
 Automatically pause the game when adjusting cameras


While we were at it:

 We added a toggle in the settings that turns off the OG bling. This is a temporary solution, but for those who've been waiting - take your bling now, it won't stay there for long!
 Fixed recentering button in settings and after calibration for Steam users


GL HF
- One Hamsa

* Fair warning - the Camera Toolbox has some performance costs and might be felt in extreme combat situations or on weaker machines.

notes.title: 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
notes.content:
What's up players?
We got you something.

[previewyoutube=UMMLl0EtBMU;full][/previewyoutube]

We also made a few changes while we were at it:

 The Settings menu now has a Recenter button. This should solve recentering for Steam users <3
 We removed the automatic difficulty changes and made the difficulty knob always available from the Hangar. This will mostly help players who haven't finished the game and had the first act difficulty ramp up.
 We carefully removed the Jingle Balls, but don't worry, you can still add them in the Sandbox!

We're eager to share our plans with you guys, hopefully we can do that soon.
In the meantime, thanks for playing,

GL HF
- One Hamsa

notes.title: Combat BOOST Patch
notes.content:
Yo!

Just before 2025 is here, we wanted to quickly fix and patch a couple things:

[olist]
 Yeah, we amped difficulty a bit too much when you completed the game.

We like the added challenge, but the extra difficulty is now opt-in.
After you complete a run, you'll see a new knob in the hangar that lets you tune the difficulty up or down.

 Locomotion on PC VR had slight inconsistencies. It should feel & play better now.

Flip controls setting (VIVE, Index) stopped flipping the controls on PC.
Now they flip just like the good ol' days!

Some language packs got updates, especially русский which had an annoying visual issue.
[/olist]
Thank you for your amazing love & support.              
Have a great year, brattas.

Full Notes

notes.title: the COMBAT BOOST update
notes.content:
Sup everyone!
We're glad to introduce the Xmas update you didn't know you needed!
Strap up, there's a lot of new shit:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/f42dade416f06e18cc743e5e3a7c42e7cc029bd9.png
We found a new supplier of Bombots and now have 3 new Bombots types in the game; Red, yellow and blue. Each of the new bombots explosions deal a different status effect; Overheat, Shock and Turbo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/09bc5475ab954c5694a40465935a0f0acb55e87c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/0f816e853b205cb860f0e89380fa1bd53d75c795.png
Ripping enemies is now more fun and more effective, making double grabber builds viable.
Just yank them hard to deal a shitton of damage - the harder you yank, the deader they get.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/c740aa1d3c13732b0e2ec6370e79227d6db16665.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/6e153adc0dfd4696e7fcb9f8844e876f444cd01f.png
We rewrote how the level algorithm selects and spawns enemies.
Levels are now more procedurally generated, making combat feel fresh and ensuring variety every run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/99c985f4a85084bf56e1be45f25004b0d0b5c75c.png
To celebrate Xmas and the first coming of Shanta, we've bestowed Jingle Balls (AKA Festicles) upon all the enemies in the game (except Pricella, because... well...).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/bb6ec310b5f6f23e6d62b09baad6193e8fe73db5.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/6816efc19f513544f1e68c2118065fd06673c687.png
Alphadogs are now more fun to play against.
Their attacks more predictable - they lock in on a target and charge at it from a distance, with little ability to change course.

They can also be countered while attacking.
Alphas no longer go Turbo while attacking, and don't intercept anything around - so if you evade well enough you can smack'em upside the head.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/0bfe0f999c79825cbac0f8cefcba07b416d8f694.gif

Overall, Alphas are no longer a "stop everything and run" enemy - they're now more of a "focus and time your attack" enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/f229de654abecdb8981c608ccf350921fc5aded3.png
We changed repairs so you're never stuck without them, but find yourself closer to death more frequently.

On top of all of these
we have a ton of small improvements to the game, balance tweaks and bug fixes.
Check out the full changelog here or in the ingame News Feed.

Hope you all have a good holiday season <3

GL HF
- One Hamsa

notes.title: BUZZSAW!
notes.content:
Since the dawn of time, man has looked at the world and dreamed of SAWING THE FUCK OUT OF SHIT.

And now, our dear brattas and sistas, that dream is our reality 🙏😑 

Introducing: [spoiler]THE BUZZSAW! (Duh...)[/spoiler]
[previewyoutube=CMqe390my_8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Buzzsaw has been a long  time coming - not only does it appear in our cover art, but it is also one of the first weapons ever prototyped in UNDERDOGS, and the second most requested feature.
We're excited with how it came out and glad to make good on our promise!

This update includes quite a bit of other changes, here are the main ones:

 THE BUZZSAW
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/86264d5246fa9a53bc027a18e8e647cac944af57.gif
The Buzzsaw and its three unique addons are now available from ACT I. They appear in shops and hails, but particularly Apache's patron rewards changed to Advanced Tech (such as the Buzzsaw), and Nait now has more  chance of having the Buzzsaw addons.
You can try out the buzzsaw immediately from the main menu!


 News runs now start with a random unlocked weapon! This can be toggled off by checking the Vanilla Rilla checkbox in the Hangar.
 Ussam got a major behavior boost. He's now more dangerous and requires higher skill to finish off.
 Jacks' got some love - their physics respond better, their arms are easier to destroy, and we've added a mini-jack at the end of Day 4 as preparation for the new Ussam.
 NPC and Item unlocks relaxed - more items and NPCs are available from the beginning of the career, and number of possbile item unlocks per run increased.
 Added RUSSIAN!
 Added Auto-Skip Seen Cutscenes option to the Settings.
 Sandboxxer Challenges unlock conditions relaxed.
 Fixed adult filter on king’s voice lines in Quest 2


There's a bunch more changes and fixes in this update, all listed in the game's News Feed.

GO SAW OFF SOME FACES!

 GL HF
- 1/5

notes.title: SANDBOXXER IS HERE!
notes.content:
Brattas and sistas, it's here.
Sandboxxer is a brand new game mode featuring tons of UNDERDOGS mini-games, and the tools to create and share your own.

Wanna make 4 Ussams fight each other? You got it.
Wanna drop in for a ten minute fitness challenge? You got it.
Wanna try an insane build and fight 10 turbo Junkdogs with 500 HP? You got it!
Wanna make a crazy-ass level and watch everyone compete over the high-scores? You got it!!!

Ok ok. You get it.
This update opens everything in UNDERDOGS for you guys to play with, and unlocks a huge amount of new content.


Main features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/ad6dcc9f5347dc049a31c66e0429155d3d3d8317.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/ec563a22240a21e7ba42ba12a91b444c8b9c1c99.gif
Our own hand-crafted mini-games, unlockable through the campaign, featuring completion levels and leaderboards.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/13562af2cbb7a7ff27efd6517dc2d9f550e821e2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/e9ce2f36f57ede899ac152640739192b026f7ff7.gif
A massive tool that lets you create anything; from throwing in a 50 exploding barrels for the lolz, to creating elaborate mini-games with your own rules.
This is the exact same tool we used to make the Challenges.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/3ba989a7903982230791572d9c4f0eb06f3c7644.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/f35c94d37374c55d4669e16b7ccac6efefeb3166.gif
Share your level with everyone, and browse, play, rate and compete over and endless variety of levels created by our... ahum... not at all unhinged community...



More features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/cb7bde2cc255d12c25eb066b6a4418f6523c35b5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/de532f57ff2566cd299b71f107fc4013d7d0cd53.png
Our first batch of Steam achievements, connected to the Challenges. F*ckin finally!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/16ff4dc91c9e9e0c74ddc621e19b2569c976e5da.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/0ef0c20debaf03ca92ccdb07075cbd65fa4adc93.gif
A new practice room to train in, try our different builds, enemy combinations and props.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/7773471a3c27acac94109dcb2c9b3fe278fd1265.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/9fc48685270cdcdff58f34a445dbd690b3181b08.gif
You can now finally play the Skirmish with any equipment you've unlocked!
Have fun, boys and girls.


We can't wait to see what you crazy madafakas do with the Sandboxxer update!

GL HF
- 1/5

notes.title: DANGEROUS STREETS UPDATE
notes.content:
Sup all!
Work on the Sandboxxer update continues in full, and in the meantime we've got a little surprise update for you: Dangerous Streets.

What's in it?

New Hails!
We made 4 new hail events for ACT II, introducing new characters such as Lashiffa and Ponette:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/8d24df6af4b427cb7aff31cab1880d7415a7b3a9.gif

And adding new tale mechanics such as Raid:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/a8a31bc68abc4269e8e340ca61910a64b6345f7a.png
Next time you play ACT II you'll have a higher chance of getting these events, so go looking for some trouble!

New Passive Items!
We've added 4 new passive items that affect street fights and stealing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/fc4c0f6fbcf9fe99cd034d0110b783f33a6af9cc.png
These items are available in ACT I and ACT II, in some specific hails and shops. Get them to find out what they do.

Busted!
Tried stealing? Got caught and burnt? All shop owners now have a new illustration when they catch you stealing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/8b90092266ff2cf48236e3c04156d09279cbe4d8.png
Ever wonder what Zikitta has under her desk? Try stealing from her and find out!

Audio Upgrade!
We've updated our audio spatializer plugin and re-adjusted our SFX spatial settings - everything should sound that much better now!
We also improved the ambient SFX in between fights - the background sound of The Jungle's streets is more gritty and real than ever.

More Shit?!
You veterans can now skip any cutscene, including boss intros, by long-pressing the trigger.
We've also slightly upped the chance of getting Weapons in shops, hails and Patron rewards.

That's it for now, more stuff is cooking,

GL HF
- 1/5








P.S.
Here's a nice GIF from the new Hails we didn't have anywhere else the put:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/ec733d3755f1be9c7960deae1b7b3d468877827b.gif

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - BLEEEEEEP
notes.content:
Parents rejoice, the Adult Filter is now functional!

By toggling it on in the Settings menu, profanity will be censored (in texts, King's voice lines, and by muting the music's lyrics) and gory scenes will be blurred out.

We've also solved a few bugs and minor issues.

 GL HF!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - Wrecking ball!
notes.content:
The studio's at work on The Sandboxxer Update, which is shaping up even better than anticipated. But before we dive head-on into its production, we've got a small update for yall.

New weapon just dropped: THE WRECKING BALL!

The Wrecking Ball is a high-skill blunt weapon that, when used well, can cause tons of DMG and provide for great crowd control.

[previewyoutube=_IpBF3Ct67M;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also added Event Sound-Bites.

As of now, every event in UNDERDOGS has a unique sound-bite that plays when you visit!
We've been wanting to add this for a long time and were finally able to implement it.
It's a small touch that we feel adds a lot of character.

And finally, we've made lots of small improvements and bug fixes.
These include:

Fixed situations where the grappling hook could be stuck underground or in walls
Fixed issues with recentering while playing on Quest Link
Fixed the bindings for Windows Mixed Reality headsets
Added launch options to Steam (OpenVR/Oculus)
Improved the Ultra setting of the Shadow Quality on PC


Check out the full release notes, including some more details about the wrecking ball.

GL HF
- 1/5
